verdict.rationale: Tailscale is a SaaS connectivity platform with a coordination service, and it also ships an AI gateway (Aperture). Whether customer data is used for AI training is therefore a fair privacy-posture question, so the axis applies. The pack contains no training opt-out, data-use policy, or no-training commitment. Aperture's ability to inspect or block LLM requests is an adjacent control, not a guarantee against training on user data.
